# Data Source: tfe_organization_membership

Gets information about an organization membership.

~> **Note:** This data source requires using the provider with HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise at least as recent as v202004-1.

~> **Note:** If a user updates their email address, configurations using the email address should be updated manually.

-> **Note**: While `email` and `username` are optional arguments, one or the other is required if `organization_membership_id` argument is not provided.

## Example Usage

```python
import constructs as constructs
import cdktf as cdktf
# Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
# See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.
import ...gen.providers.tfe as tfe
class MyConvertedCode(cdktf.TerraformStack):
    def __init__(self, scope, name):
        super().__init__(scope, name)
        tfe.data_tfe_organization_membership.DataTfeOrganizationMembership(self, "test",
            email="user@example.com",
            organization="my-org-name"
        )
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email of the user.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization.
- `organization_membership_id` (String) ID belonging to the organization membership.
- `username` (String) The username of the user associated with the organization membership.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization membership ID.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user associated with the organization membership.
